title: The conceivability and knowledge arguments refute only a structural physicalism

statements.text: At most, the conceivability and knowledge arguments show that structure alone does not fix consciousness. A zombie world that seems conceivable is only a structural duplicate of this one, misdescribed as a physical duplicate, and Mary in her black and white room learns only the structural part of the truth, missing the quiddistic part.

sources.quote: If such a world initially appears conceivable, this is because we mistake a zombie world for a structural zombie world
we misdescribe the conceived world as physically identical to ours, when in fact it is just structurally identical
Russellian physicalism, on which the class of physical truths includes not only structural truths but quiddistic truths as well, is not threatened
